newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan buys 100,000 tonnes of Syrian barley - trade.
newsitem.headline: Jordan buys 100,000 tonnes of Syrian barley - trade.

text.p: Jordan has bought 100,000 tonnes of black barley at $155 per tonne FOT, traders said on Monday.
Traders said the deal was at the high end in view of current world prices of around $140-$150 per tonne FOB, but is probably linked to Syrian purchases of Jordanian cement.
Jordan bought 100,000 tonnes of Syrian barley at $175 per tonne last June and a significant amount of the shipment is still being trucked, traders said.
Jordan's annual consumption of barley is around 500,000 tonnes.
